messages:
sasha: Quick sync on the kernel + continuous-batching sprint — milestone check. Owning leads: kernel=alex, batching=maya, kv-cache=ron. Need confirmation on PR readiness, canary timing, and infra deps. Target: keep p50 < 45ms for common seq lengths. Who's free for a quick async status?

alex: I own the kernel primitives. PR #4123 (kernel-refactor) is functionally done, failing a flaky A100 test. Waiting on a repro from QA. I can carve out time to fix the test today.

maya: Batching side is green. I landed change in #4156 to `max_batch=32`, `batch_wait_ms=6`. Microbench showed ~10% throughput improvement for small seqs. I also added a toggle `enable_continuous_batches` for rollout.

ron: KV prefetch work is in #4088. Main change is async prefetch + smarter eviction window. I think kernel needs a small API flag `prefetch_async=true` to avoid blocking hotpath. @alex can you add that to the runtime schema?

alex: yep I can add `prefetch_async` and a schema bump. Will open a small patch that both kernel and runtime teams can pin to. Also can review #4123 in ~45m. @sam @maya please add notes if there are known regressions. :eyes:

sam: pinging for review on #4123 — I can't merge until it gets 1 more approver and the CI token is stable. If alex can do first pass I'll address comments quickly.

maya: I'll do a runtime-level integration test against the new batching flags this afternoon. If you need me to review kernel changes I can do that after infra image lands.

eng-oncall-bot: Canary window requested: 2026-03-18T03:30:00Z -> 2026-03-18T04:30:00Z in us-west-2. Notifying oncall rotation: priya.

priya: I'll own the canary watch. Alerts I'll enable: error-rate > 0.5% (5m), p95 latency > 200ms (5m), token drop anomalies. Will post logs + flamegraphs to the thread if anything spikes.

sasha: Infra dep: eng-infra needs to build kernel image with new NVF userland for canary. @tom can you take that? Without the image we can't run the kernel-refactor on dedicated pools.

tom: taking it. I expect the image by EOD. I'll also add a CI test tag `kernel-canary` to the image pipeline and update the deploy job.

ron: One more dependency note: KV prefetch toggles require a small change in the routing layer to set `prefetch_async` when model size > 13B. I'll open a tiny PR today.

alex: good call. Let's make that routing change conditional so we don't flip on small models. Also add a feature flag for canary.

sam: repro for the flaky test added to #4123 — steps + logs + a small harness. @alex should make it easier to reproduce locally.

sasha: added a short checklist in the PR description: kernel schema bump, infra image, canary manifest, monitoring playbook, rollback criteria.

maya: canary manifest (snippet):
```yaml
canary: true
deployment:
  pool: dedicated-usw2-small
  image_tag: kernel-refactor-canary
  env:
    ENABLE_CONTINUOUS_BATCHES: "true"
    PREFETCH_ASYNC: "true"
traffic: 10%
metrics_watch:
  - p95_latency_ms
  - error_rate
```

alex: looks good — small nit: use `PREFETCH_ASYNC=true` only when routing layer flips the flag. I'll coordinate with ron.

priya: I'll attach a minimal runbook to the canary run: quick rollback commands and where to cut traffic back to 0.

eng-oncall-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-18T03:30:00Z in us-west-2. Oncall: priya. Notifications sent to #eng-oncall.

sasha: next steps: alex pushes schema bump PR, ron finalizes KV toggle PR, tom publishes image, maya prepares canary manifest and deploy job, priya watches. Sam & QA validate flaky test repro. If anyone needs extra hands ping here.

alex: I'll push the schema change in the next 2 hours and ping for review.

tom: image build kicked — will post digest when done.

sam: thanks everyone, I'll queue the final CI run after alex's patch.

sasha: great progress — i'll update the sprint tracker and mark milestone `runtime: canary-ready` when tom posts the image digest. :thumbsup:

(priya reacted :eyes:)
